::: {#about-block}
Hi there! \
I am Raji (pronounced "RAH-jee").\

I am a graduate research assistant at the University of Florida, where I apply Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) and systems modeling to analyze sustainability in supply chain logistics. I'm a first-generation graduate and researcher — the first in my family to complete a college degree, let alone go on to a Master's. That journey has shaped how I think as a researcher: driven by perseverance, curiosity, and a deep respect for education.
:::
